scope: Static schema for JumpStand, JumpStandMediator, Switch, DelaySwitch; runtime implements world01-01 relay subset only
input: Original raw actorCreateParamList or imported source-world actors, population count 2..8; caller owns verified directional collision facts and velocity unit conversion

parameterEncoding.integer: numeric FP arithmetic shift by 16; flags compare integer portion

JumpStand.fieldPointerConvention: Disassembly value-type pointer offsets equal metadata boxed offsets minus 16

animation.evidence: .cctor metadata literals usage 0xa00008ff->literal1151=0.2 and 0xa00008df->literal1135=0.0833333333333333, parsed by 0x18163fcb0

JumpStand.trigger: SwitchOn event61 sender actor type95 (JumpStandMediator), exact sender name equals parent. If visible and phase0, phase=1. On next OnUpdate phase1 sets animation2 and phase2 timer windup. Phase2 expires: notifyJump; phase3 recovery; phase3 expiry phase0. Unparented stands call notifyJump every visible update.
JumpStand.impulse: notifyJump 0x181868c60 obtains UP-face contacts nonrecursively, mask -1; skips contacted collisions with any UP-face contact. Sends event36 to each remaining actor with configured velocity. If affectAll false and layer1 Player, sets x=0. If keepVeloX, replaces x with contacted actor current x velocity and event integer field at0x70=1.

switchModes.1: visible while count>0; when count drops0, waits delay then disappears only if phase0
switchModes.2: initially visible; count>0 disappears only if phase0; count0 waits delay before appearing
switchModes.3: toggles visibility with appear/disappear intervals, waits phase0 before disappearing

JumpStandMediator.trigger: Receives event61 only, obtains own event61 parameter (sender is mediator), broadcasts through Frame.NotifyEvent to actor type16 JumpStand; no global occupancy threshold

Switch.position: Select offset pair for count n, walking down to smaller count until either x or y nonzero; add pair to actor position. Entire 56 exclamation mark encoded tables in world01-01 represent zero.

upwardCollisionRect.evidence: SwitchComponent..cctor 0x181715468..0x1817154f5 writes height9,width18,x-9,y-9 to static+0x20; GetCollisionByDirection default direction0 selects static+0x20

Switch.contact: Normal type0 accepts collided collision attribute bit1 plus layer1,2,3 or8. Physics type1 bypasses this filter. Direction0 is source UP.
Switch.events: ON61 and OFF60 to target and subtarget exact actor names, with own actor as sender, switchId and timerAddSeconds fields. Repeat enables another rising contact after release; default contact latch persists until forced off.

slots.5: delay seconds increment per player above2

DelaySwitch.trigger: Sets Switch flags bit9 manual notification. ON transition callback starts remaining=delay. Delay OnUpdate subtracts dt; when remaining<=0, NotifyTarget(true), sets Switch flags bit3 request off, clears remaining. OFF callback does nothing, so early release does not cancel countdown. Request off rearms latch; held contact may begin another countdown on subsequent update.

limits: No original DLL execution or assets publishing
Population offset string grammar outside zero first-stage tables unresolved
Native actor velocity to web pixels/second conversion requires player integration
Runtime expects actual native-direction collision facts; it does not fabricate terrain or pressure occupancy
Native event ordering and physics integration fidelity require caller integration
